Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect trigger when this card is in the breeding area and would digivolve into a card with [Avian], [Bird], [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign], other than [Sea Animal], in any of its traits?

Effect: [Your Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve into a Digimon card with [Avian], [Bird], [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign], other than [Sea Animal], in any of its traits, reduce the cost by 1.
